metadata.name: CashPilot
metadata.description: CashPilot runs passive income services on your own server and shows what they earn in one web dashboard. It starts the services that run in Docker with one click from its catalog, keeps track of the ones that run as a browser extension, a desktop app or a GPU node, and reads the providers' balances into one earnings history. A balance drop is offered to you as a probable payout to confirm, and stored credentials are encrypted at rest. Two containers: the web UI and a worker, which is the only one with the Docker socket. On the first visit, enter the one-time setup token printed in the cashpilot-ui container log to create the owner account. Keep port 8080 on your LAN: the dashboard can command the worker, and the worker holds the Docker socket.
metadata.tagline: Run passive income services and see what they earn
metadata.author: GeiserX

environment_variables.name: CASHPILOT_SECRET_KEY
environment_variables.description: Signs login sessions. Leave empty and CashPilot generates one on first start and keeps it in /data.

environment_variables.name: CASHPILOT_UI_URL
environment_variables.description: URL the worker uses to reach the CashPilot UI

environment_variables.name: CASHPILOT_WORKER_NAME
environment_variables.description: Name of this worker in the dashboard

volumes.description: UI database and the key that decrypts stored credentials (/data/.fernet_key). Back it up.
Enrolment key shared between the UI and the worker
Docker socket, which the worker needs to start and stop the earning containers

before_install.en_us:
The dashboard can command the worker, and the worker holds the Docker socket, so keep port 8080 on your LAN and never forward it to the internet.

On the first visit CashPilot asks for a setup token. Find it in the logs of the cashpilot-ui container, in the line that says "setup token". It then creates the owner account and opens the setup wizard.

Back up /data/.fernet_key from the cashpilot-ui container: without it the stored credentials cannot be decrypted.
